[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested Korean-Indian fusion dishes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Kimchi Naan Tacos: Spicy kimchi slaw, crispy naan "tortillas," and tender bulgogi beef or chicken.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Bibimbap Biryani: A Korean-inspired rice bowl dish with a flavorful Indian-style biryani base, topped with an assortment of vegetables, a fried egg, and a spicy gochujang sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. K-Town Chicken Tikka: Marinate chicken in a blend of Korean chili flakes (gochugaru) and Indian yogurt, then grill or bake and serve with a side of cilantro-lime rice and kimchi raita.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Spicy Kimchi Samosas: Crunchy samosas filled with a kimchi-spiced potato and pea mixture, served with a side of cucumber-mint chutney.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Jeyuk bokkeum Quesadilla: A Korean-style stir-fry with pork, kimchi, and vegetables, wrapped inside a crispy naan "quesadilla" with melted cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for making perfect naan bread at home:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Use a hot skillet or tava.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Choose high-protein flour.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use a yeast starter or active dry yeast.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Let the dough rest for at least 2 hours or overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Use a gentle touch when shaping the dough.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Don't overwork the dough.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Brush with ghee or oil before baking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Cook for 1-2 minutes on each side.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Serve immediately.
